# Physical conditional preparation without learning the hidden law

29 October 2026. Root synthesis and construction. Conditional resampling and
heat-bath methods are established. The result here specifies a physical
supplier and retained-record theorem, not a new Gibbs-sampling identity.

## 1. What a preparation supplier must add

The bounded counter changes an invariant law using unknown native dynamics.
It need not convert the currently held specimen to that law. Visible stopping
can choose the right observed label yet leave a biased hidden conditional
state. The four-state obstruction shows that even common rapid microscopic
mixing does not supply a universally exact visible stopping rule of finite mean.

Two constructive escapes are actual recognition of a chosen full state, or an
operation restoring the required conditional law uniformly over unresolved
states and retained records. The latter can avoid learning the hidden dynamics.
It is stronger than an invariant-law promise: it must actually remove the
relevant selection-induced memory at the promised tolerance.

## 2. One conditional operation for a whole target family

Let X be a standard measurable physical state space and Y:X->{1,...,k} an
actual noninvasive label. A warranted baseline mu has positive label masses
pi_y and conditional laws mu_y. These conditional laws need not be explicitly
known or represented by a finite predictive model. For any desired label
distribution q, define the full microscopic target

    nu_q = sum_y q_y mu_y.                                  (1)

For visible weights w, q_y=pi_y w_y / sum_z pi_z w_z. Alternatively q can be
specified directly without knowing pi. Knowing q does not supply a physical
way to set a state distributed as the unknown conditional law mu_y.

The ideal conditional replacement kernel

    E(x,dx') = mu_{Y(x)}(dx')                               (2)

fixes the label, obeys E²=E, and preserves every target (1). It is initially
only a mathematical comparison object. A real supplier must implement or
approximate it with an actual information and timing interface.

# Selective memory thermalization: a constructive preparation escape

29 October 2026. Root mathematical receiver and full-record consequence.
This is an additional physical-operation model, not an apparatus claim.

## 1. A continuous state that stores an apparently memoryless record

Take (u,v) in [0,1)^2 with uniform baseline mu. Define the standard baker
map, apart from null binary-expansion ambiguities, by

 S(u,v)=(2u-b,(v+b)/2),          b=floor(2u),
 S^(-1)(u,v)=((u+c)/2,2v-c),    c=floor(2v).                 (1)

Both are supplied mathematical native operations. They preserve area:
each branch has determinant one and the two branch images partition the
square. In binary coordinates write

 u=.b_0 b_1 b_2...,       v=.b_(-1) b_(-2) b_(-3)... .

S shifts the binary origin forward by one, and S^(-1) shifts it backward.
Under mu all these bits are iid fair. The sole native visible read is
Y=b_0, xi=2Y-1. A forward record is exactly iid even though v stores its
past. The map is an idealized piecewise area-preserving operation, not the
smooth addressed diffusion of continuation3 and not a fabricated Hamiltonian
apparatus. Its actual duration, isolation and sensing would need suppliers.

For 0<a<1 the full target is

    nu(du,dv)=[1+a(2 floor(2u)-1)]du dv.                    (2)

With only (1), the root shift-coupling argument forces infinite square-root
moment for exact preparation, even when both directions and the full state
are known. Finite-error preparation has mean native cost Omega(1/epsilon),
and the root matching construction attains that order. Its future inverse
reads make the hidden-state accuracy consequential rather than a purely
unobservable mathematical demand.

## 2. The strong ordinary route and its precise failure

Execute S at least once. At each resulting endpoint accept with probability

# Preparation from stationary fluctuations and retained physical memory

29 October 2026. Astra P1 root construction. Earlier files are unchanged.

## 1. Question and predecessor boundary

The bounded stationary counter does not prepare its invariant law from the
baseline. This continuation asks what physical resource upgrades invariance
to actual preparation on one persistent specimen, without learning hidden
dynamics. The independently selected fixed-clock flow construction is retained
as a real alternative. After reading it and its strong existing probability-
flow predecessors, root selected preparation as the central investigation.

Palm transport, Liggett's extra-head matching, Holroyd–Peres allocations,
Last–Thorisson transports, Mörters–Redl embeddings, and Thorisson's
shift-coupling/Cesaro inequality are established mechanisms. They are NOT
claimed as inventions here. The contribution under investigation is their
physical preparation interface, finite-error resource separation, observable
acquisition, and an actual additional operation that removes the obstruction.
The complementary four-state unknown-kernel theorem is a separate result.

## 2. Actual-state preparation inequality

Let S be an invertible measurable map preserving probability mu on a standard
Borel microscopic space. The actual menu is S and, if supplied, S^(-1).
Starting at X_0~mu, any controller ending at its current state has

    X_out=S^J X_0,       |J|<=K,                              (1)

where K is its total number of native calls. The bound allows arbitrary
sensing, computation, calibration information and randomization, even complete
knowledge of X_0 and S. No other physical action, new specimen, overwrite,
reset or copy is supplied. Forward and inverse calls each have unit cost.

Let nu=g mu, g>=0, mu(g)=1, and TV(Law(X_out),nu)<=epsilon. Define

    F_n=E_mu |sum_(j=0)^(n-1)[g(S^j X_0)-1]|.                 (2)

For every n>=1,

    F_n/2 <= E min(K,n)+n epsilon,
    E K >= sup_n [F_n/2-n epsilon].                         (3)

**Proof.** Put A_n(x)=n^(-1)sum_(j=0)^(n-1)delta_(S^j x).
The orbit windows A_n(x), A_n(S^J x) share at least (n-|J|)_+ entries,
counting multiplicity, so their TV distance is at most min(|J|/n,1).
Averaging the actual endpoint coupling and using mu A_n=mu gives
TV(rho A_n,mu)<=E min(K/n,1), where rho=Law(X_out). Contraction gives
TV(nu A_n,mu)<=epsil
